title: OpenEI Utility Rate Database (URDB)
publisher: OpenEI / National Laboratory of the Rockies
format: REST JSON; full downloadable database advertised
access: Free API key documented; manual search and download alternatives. Documentation/catalog primary search results inspected; direct pages returned429 during this research.
license_or_terms: Record-specific primary reuse license must be verified before common seeding; conflicting third-party CC0/CC-BY descriptions are not sufficient. Raw utility documents have separate terms.
cadence: Continuously maintained; rates have individual start/end/update dates
limitations: US-specific; not every rider/tax or tariff complete/current. Native importer already handles supported rates and explicit refusals; unsupported terms must not become a total bill.
integration_mode: Reuse native urdb_to_tariff importer; select by utility, voltage/class/service and valid date; review, pin, retain source URI and refused fields. Rights-gated common seed or tenant-local import.
verification: Official source documentation/terms researched; no data API authenticated or bulk dataset executed

title: PG&E official electric tariff book, including B-20
access: Public tariff index and linked B-20 official PDF; no API established
license_or_terms: Public regulatory material; specific copying/redistribution and document restrictions require review, not assumed open license.
cadence: Tariff revisions/advice-letter effective dates; potentially multiple per year
limitations: Example regional utility only. Official sheets govern; URDB record may lag. Rate schedules depend on class/voltage/options and bundled-versus-generation service; new B-20 versus legacy E-20 eligibility matters.
integration_mode: Curated official-host document parser into native tariff schema; per-field source spans and review; known-bill fixture. No whole-book copying until terms resolved.
verification: Official source documentation/terms researched; no data API authenticated or bulk dataset executed

title: EIA Open Data v2 and fuel/retail price series
parameter_families: natural gas and petroleum price series
format: REST JSON; spreadsheet/CSV and bulk routes
access: Free API key required for API; public downloadable series also available
license_or_terms: EIA states its publications are public domain, with attribution requested and exceptions for identified third-party content; API terms and rate limits still apply.
limitations: State/sector average revenues per kWh are benchmarks, not executable tariffs. Gas/petroleum hub or retail prices require delivery/tax/heating-value basis; not PPA quotes or hourly forward forecasts.
integration_mode: Seed clearly labelled benchmark series from identified EIA-owned products; optional refresh adapter; stage timezone/currency/units and revision metadata in native series_store.
verification: Official source documentation/terms researched; no data API authenticated or bulk dataset executed

title: PJM Data Miner 2
access: Public search; PJM account/API subscription key for automation. Published connection limits differ by member status.
license_or_terms: Official Data Miner terms restrict use to internal purposes and prohibit redistributing raw or derived data without a PJM-issued redistribution license.
limitations: Public does not mean seedable. Node/hub, DA/RT, finality and time basis differ. An open-source wrapper does not grant redistribution rights.
integration_mode: Reference catalog entry only until permitted use established; tenant/user-held licensed connection where allowed. No common seed, bundle export or transformed-data promotion without license.
verification: Official source documentation/terms researched; no data API authenticated or bulk dataset executed

title: CAISO OASIS and historical pricing downloader
geography: US-CAISO and applicable western market locations
parameter_families: DA/RT nodal and aggregate price series
format: OASIS ZIP/XML/CSV downloads; historical bulk portal
access: Public OASIS report URLs and historical downloader. Historical pricing portal advertises records since2016; endpoint/product limits must be honored.

cadence: Market product intervals and subsequent revisions; bulk archive updates

integration_mode: Optional approved-source series import after scoped rights check; retain report ID/location/market/revision and archive source; avoid default live price dependency.
verification: Official source documentation/terms researched; no data API authenticated or bulk dataset executed

title: Bonneville Power Administration power/transmission rate schedules
format: Official PDF rate schedules and decision documents
access: Public rate schedule and case pages; current rates include adjustments/supplemental proceedings
license_or_terms: Federal agency primary documents; confirm document-specific third-party/notices and current published terms before common packaging.
limitations: BPA means Bonneville, distinct from PPA. Base BP-26 schedules do not guarantee current bill without subsequent rate adjustments/BP-27 and eligibility/product terms. Not a generic US industrial tariff.

verification: Official source documentation/terms researched; no data API authenticated or bulk dataset executed

title: Ontario Energy Board distribution-rate open data
parameter_families: historical distribution rates all rate classes
format: XLSX historical databases; XML current limited-class datasets; regulatory sheets

license_or_terms: Publisher open-data inventory links Open Government Licence Ontario; attribution and exclusions apply. Verify each chosen asset is included before release.
cadence: Historical distribution-rate database annually; selected current rate XML monthly
limitations: Distribution-only charges are not commodity/Global Adjustment/transmission/taxes total. Large-industrial applicability must come from actual rate class/sheets. Open/Public is access label, while licence coverage must remain attached to source asset.
integration_mode: Seed eligible OGL-labelled records and derived native tariff entries with exact classes/effective dates; reconcile known bill and explicitly unsupported charges.
verification: Official source documentation/terms researched; no data API authenticated or bulk dataset executed
